name: hcapp_updateDownDown
description: Updates an existing DownDown: charge text, song choice/id, optionally the charge photo, and (since 2026-09-26) who is charged — app hashers (HC.DownDownHashers) and typed names (DownDowns.ExternalNames). Auth: HC6.ValidateAppAuth (spNumber 58). Gate: the charge's creator may always edit; anyone else needs HC6.CheckKennelPermission 'manageDownDowns' for @kennelId (else 1337). Scoped to id + EventId + KennelId (no row → 4041). chargePhotoUrl is merged with COALESCE — NULL leaves the photo, and there is no way to clear it. The text/song UPDATE and the people change run in one transaction. New feature — no HC5 equivalent.

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: Registered device UUID. Passed to HC6.ValidateAppAuth for auth resolution.

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Short-lived auth token validated against DeviceSecret.

parameters.name: kennelId
parameters.description: Kennel that owns the event. Used as auth scope and as part of the UPDATE WHERE clause. Required — null or zero-UUID triggers validation error. Defaults to NULL when omitted (2026-10-13).

parameters.name: eventId
parameters.description: Event the DownDown belongs to. Used as part of the UPDATE WHERE clause. Required — null or zero-UUID triggers validation error. Defaults to NULL when omitted (2026-10-13).

parameters.name: downDownId
parameters.description: DownDown to update. Required — null or zero-UUID triggers validation error. If no DownDown matches downDownId + eventId + kennelId, returns errorCode 4041, errorType 3. Defaults to NULL when omitted (2026-10-13).

parameters.name: chargeText
parameters.description: New charge text. Required — empty or whitespace-only triggers validation error. Defaults to NULL when omitted (2026-10-13).

parameters.name: songChoice
parameters.description: Updated suggested song name (free text). Always written: stored trimmed, or NULL if blank/omitted. NVARCHAR(500) matches DownDowns.SongChoice.

parameters.name: songId
parameters.description: Updated FK to HC.Song. Always written: NULL (or omitting it) CLEARS the song association.

parameters.name: chargePhotoUrl
parameters.description: Updated charge photo blob URL. Uses COALESCE(@chargePhotoUrl, ChargePhotoUrl) — passing NULL leaves the existing value unchanged. There is no way to clear the photo via this SP.

parameters.name: hasherIds
parameters.description: Since 1.1.0 (2026-09-26): pipe-delimited hasher UUIDs to charge, replacing the current set ('' = none). NULL = unchanged (older apps). Ids that are not real hashers are ignored.

parameters.name: externalNames
parameters.description: Since 1.1.0 (2026-09-26): JSON array of names of people not in the app, replacing the current names ('[]' = none; blanks dropped, names trimmed). NULL = unchanged.

rowsets.name: ErrorEnvelope
rowsets.description: On any failure: { success = 0, errorCode, errorType } then the detail at index 1. ValidateAppAuth codes; 1234 missing parameter or blank @chargeText (2); 4041 not found (3); 1337 not creator and not authorised (3); 1236 the edit would leave nobody charged (2); 1933 unhandled (5).

rowsets.name: SuccessEnvelope
rowsets.description: Returned on successful update: { success=1, errorCode=NULL, errorType=NULL }. Mutually exclusive with ErrorEnvelope rowset.
Returned (at index 1) alongside the ErrorEnvelope (index 0) on any auth, validation, not-found, or unhandled error.

sideEffects: Updates HC.DownDowns: sets ChargeText, SongChoice, SongId, ChargePhotoUrl (via COALESCE), UpdatedAt where id + eventId + kennelId match.
Writes to HC.ErrorLog on auth, validation, not-found, or unhandled errors.

With @hasherIds/@externalNames: replaces HC.DownDownHashers rows and DownDowns.ExternalNames in the same transaction as the text update; refuses (errorCode 1236, errorType 2) an edit that would leave nobody charged.

codeSmells.detail: These parameters have no SQL default, so a call that omits one is refused by SQL Server before the procedure runs (unlogged empty 500): @deviceId, @accessToken. On 2026-10-13 every parameter whose body already handled NULL (and every sync watermark) was given a default; these remain because they are the auth pair or the body never checks them for NULL.

codeSmells.issue: No way to clear ChargePhotoUrl via this SP
codeSmells.detail: ChargePhotoUrl is updated with COALESCE(@chargePhotoUrl, ChargePhotoUrl). If the caller wants to remove a charge photo, there is no way to do it through this SP — passing NULL leaves the existing URL. A sentinel empty-string or a separate @clearPhoto flag would be needed to support photo removal.

Line 9. Free text from the user; a longer value is cut to 500 with no error (CLAUDE.md 'NVARCHAR(n) parameter that receives user text'). It matches the column, so the fix is NVARCHAR(MAX) + a LEN() check.

codeSmells.issue: Song fields are overwrite-always while people fields are NULL-means-unchanged
codeSmells.detail: Lines 211-212 write SongChoice and SongId unconditionally, so a caller that omits them wipes the song, whereas @chargePhotoUrl, @hasherIds and @externalNames treat NULL as 'leave it'. Inconsistent semantics within one SP.
Line 152 declares @changePeople BIT; the project bans BIT (SMALLINT).
Line 138: a permission refusal is errorType 3 (the 'not found' family, same as 4041); other SPs use 13.
